name: [⚔️] Merge Your Army! 🧟‍♂️
desc:
Your army is under attack! 🚨
Use code "SMALLUPDATE" in shop! 🏆

ZOMBIES are coming in waves! Merge your defenders, equip them, and fight to survive. Defeat massive BOSSES to push forward!

[How To Play]
• 🧩 Merge defenders to make them stronger
• 🎒 Equip your army
• ⚔️ Fight endless waves of zombies
• 👑 Defeat bosses to unlock new stages

how powerful can you make your army? 💥
